briefTitle: A Study of GV20-0251 Monotherapy and GV20-0251 in Combination With Pembrolizumab in Participants With Solid Tumor Malignancies

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Previously treated, histologically-confirmed advanced solid malignancy with progressive disease requiring therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General solid tumor inclusion rule without a specific NSCLC stage list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Refractory or intolerant to standard therapy(ies)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Refractory/intolerance is a general prior treatment status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must have received, be not eligible or decline standard of care therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Subjective trial eligibility condition regarding standard of care.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have measurable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST version 1.1)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: For participants who have received prior treatment with a checkpoint inhibitor there must be documented disease progression
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Conditional prior treatment rule for checkpoint inhibitors.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Life expectancy of ≥ 12 weeks in Parts A and C and ≥ 24 weeks in Parts B and D
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must be willing to provide fresh tumor biopsy (core biopsy) both pre-treatment (Parts A, B, C and D) and on-treatment (Parts A and B), if clinically feasible
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to undergo a biopsy procedure is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Disease-free of active second/secondary or prior malignancies for ≥ 2 years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: History of prior malignancies is not a standard typed cancer-specific check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Laboratory test results within the required parameters
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General laboratory parameter requirement without specific cutoffs listed.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Women of child bearing potential (WOCBP) and men must agree to use adequate contraception
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Contraception compliance requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Parts B, C and D may include the following tumor types: Endometrial carcinoma, Squamous head and neck carcinoma, Cutaneous melanoma, Non-small cell lung cancer, Proficient MMR (pMMR)/MSS adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum (Parts C and D only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Lists specific tumor types for specific study parts rather than a primary histology check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant with acute leukemia or CLL (Parts A and B only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of acute leukemia or CLL.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant with heart disease or unstable arrhythmia
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Heart disease or arrhythmia is a clinical exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active, uncontrolled bacterial, viral, or fungal infections requiring systemic therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active infection exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant has active autoimmune disease or other medical conditions requiring chronic systemic steroid or immunosuppressive therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Autoimmune disease or chronic steroid/immunosuppressive therapy exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of major organ transplant
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ transplant history exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of a bone marrow transplant
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Bone marrow transplant history exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) malignancy or metastasis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic CNS disease is not a clean typed brain_mets status of none, treated_stable, or untreated.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Serious nonmalignant disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General exclusion for serious nonmalignant disease.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pregnant or nursing women
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy or nursing exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Treatment with PD-1 and equivalent immune modulators or major surgery prior to the first dose of study medication
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window or prior therapy restriction for PD-1/surgery without specific cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants who are currently receiving any other investigational agent or have received an investigational agent within 4 weeks prior to the first dose of study medication
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigational agent washout window.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Treatment with any anticancer treatments with 2-weeks prior to the first dose of study medication
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Anticancer treatment washout window.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Radiation for symptomatic lesions must have been completed prior to the first dose of study medication
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Radiation completion requirement prior to dosing.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with liver metastases unless approved by the Sponsor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Liver metastases exclusion with sponsor approval exception.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any history of an immune related ≥ Grade 3 AE attributed to prior cancer immunotherapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior immune-related adverse events exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 2 years from C1D1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Additional malignancy history exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received radiation therapy to the lung that is higher than 30 Gy within 6 months prior to C1D1 for NSCLC (Parts C and D only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Lung radiation dose and time threshold exclusion specific to NSCLC.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 2 years from C1D1 (Parts C and D only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Duplicate additional malignancy history exclusion for specific parts.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has severe hypersensitivity ( ≥ Grade 3) to Pembrolizumab and/or any of its excipients (Parts C and D only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hypersensitivity to study drug exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis / interstitial lung disease that required steroids or has current pneumonitis / interstitial lung disease (Parts C and D only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease history exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a condition, therapy, laboratory abnormality, or circumstance that could confound study results or interfere with full participation, making it unsuitable for the participant, as determined by the treating Investigator (Parts C and D only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator discretion-based exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active substance abuse
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active substance abuse exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic CNS disease is not a clean typed brain_mets status of none, treated_stable, or untreated.
